data.name: Ashborn Empires
data.detailed_description:
The world ended centuries ago.

Kingdoms crumbled, knowledge vanished, and humanity was forced to begin again among the ruins of a forgotten age. In this harsh land, iron is more valuable than gold, ancient relics hold secrets no one understands, and every settlement fights to survive.

Ashborn Empires is a unique co-op RTS/RPG hybrid where two players take on distinct but interconnected roles. One commands a growing civilization through classic real-time strategy gameplay, while the other fights on the front lines as a Hero in third-person action combat.

Together, you must rebuild, explore, and uncover the lost technologies of the old world.

Two Roles. One Empire.

Coordinate with a friend in a truly asymmetrical co-op experience.

As the RTS Commander, gather resources, construct settlements, research technologies, train armies, and lead your civilization through the ages.

As the Hero, explore the wilderness, battle hostile creatures and enemy warriors, recover forgotten knowledge from ancient ruins, and influence the course of every battle through skill-based combat.

Build a Civilization From the Ashes

Establish settlements, expand your economy, and transform a fragile community of survivors into a powerful empire.

Advance through multiple ages, unlock new technologies, strengthen your military, and adapt your strategy to an ever-changing battlefield.

Master Skill-Based Melee Combat

Take direct control of a Hero inspired by classic action combat systems.

Block, parry, dodge, and strike from multiple directions in fast-paced third-person battles. Develop your Hero, improve your equipment, and become a decisive force on the battlefield.

Recover Lost Knowledge

The ruins of the old world are filled with forgotten weapons, ancient technologies, and secrets waiting to be rediscovered.

Bring these discoveries back to your people to unlock new technologies, weapons and armor, improve your civilization and gain an edge over your enemies.

Fight for a New Future

Face hostile wildlife, rival civilizations, mysterious insectoid races, and the countless dangers of a world struggling to rebuild itself after catastrophe.

Whether defending your settlement, exploring ancient ruins, or leading armies into war, every victory brings humanity one step closer to reclaiming its future.

Features

  • Unique asymmetrical co-op gameplay combining RTS and third-person RPG action

  • Build settlements, manage economies, and command armies in classic RTS fashion

  • Engage in skill-based melee combat with blocking, parrying, and directional attacks

  • Explore a post-apocalyptic medieval world filled with ruins and lost technology

  • Research discoveries recovered by the Hero to unlock powerful upgrades

  • Progress through multiple ages and expand your civilization

  • Play solo, cooperatively, or compete in multiplayer matches

  • Battle hostile creatures, enemy factions, and emerging civilizations

data.short_description: Command vast armies and manage a growing empire from a classic top-down RTS perspective, or take up arms as a Hero and lead the charge in third-person combat. Explore ancient ruins, recover lost technology, and shape the fate of a fallen world together.

English*, Spanish - Spain*

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains medieval-style combat with weapons. Players can kill human enemies, hostile creatures, and insectoid foes, with mild blood effects during combat.

The game also includes themes of war, survival, resource scarcity, and (fictional) political conflict. There is no nudity, sexual content, sexual violence, drug use, self-harm, or graphic gore.
